name: CrenetGovernance
description: Centralized governance, compliance, and legal audit layer for Crenet Games repositories.

tools.name: log_ai_asset
tools.description: Logs an AI-generated asset into the active workspace's ./docs/assets_ledger.json for Steam AI disclosure and copyright defense.

tools.name: verify_environment_isolation
tools.description: Verifies active workspace compliance with strict container and network isolation protocols (git user email verification and unauthorized network profile detection).

tools.name: atomic_commit_status
tools.description: Inspects dirty/untracked files, hunk counts, static import graph, and topological commit waves for an atomic commit chain.

tools.name: atomic_commit_hunks
tools.description: Lists numbered diff hunks for a file to prepare non-interactive partial staging.

tools.name: atomic_commit_stage
tools.description: Non-interactively stages full files and/or specific numbered hunks into the Git index.

tools.name: atomic_commit_verify
tools.description: Deterministically verifies that the staged slice (HEAD + index) has no unstaged dependencies and passes checks in an isolated worktree.
